ThingDef.label: ship window: diagonal (clear)
ThingDef.description: A leaded stained-glass ship window that glazes one square of roof — a mosaic piece: rotate and combine tiles to compose your own designs (four rotations form long lines and big diamonds). On a planet's surface it channels full daylight, bright enough to grow crops; in orbit there is no sun, so it sheds only a faint starlight glow. Its clear glass passes true sunlight for Biotech genes. The glazing keeps the roof sealed, so a hull room stays airtight. It won't work under thick overhead mountain.
